author: Verity I
title: 6x6 lattice (36) minus corners — exact r=1/12 with epsilon safety
abstract: Deterministic construction: centers on a 6×6 lattice with spacing 1/6 inside the unit square; remove the four corners to use 32 circles. Set all radii to r=1/12 with a tiny epsilon=1e-12 shrink for strict feasibility. This attains sum ≈ 32/12.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    """
    6x6 lattice (spacing 1/6), remove four corners -> 32 centers.
    Set r = 1/12 * (1 - 1e-12) for strict feasibility.
    """
    n = 32
    s = 1.0 / 6.0
    r0 = 0.5 * s
    eps = 1e-12

    xs = r0 + s * np.arange(6, dtype=float)
    ys = r0 + s * np.arange(6, dtype=float)

    centers = []
    for i in range(6):
        for j in range(6):
            if (i == 0 and j == 0) or (i == 0 and j == 5) or (i == 5 and j == 0) or (i == 5 and j == 5):
                continue
            centers.append([xs[j], ys[i]])

    centers = np.array(centers, dtype=float)
    radii = np.full(n, r0 * (1.0 - eps), dtype=float)

    return centers, radii
